name: Void Core Cultivator
body:
You developed a Void Core, significantly raising your affinity and comprehension of the Void element, enabling you to to learn and cast a higher class of Void magic.

Prerequisite(s): Able to cast 1st-level spells, 1 rank in Spellcraft, the spells ability, and ki pool (or Ki Meditation feat). You may only select this feat at 1st level.

Benefit(s): You begin gameplay with a spiritual core within your soul known as a Void Core, allowing you to learn and cast spells with the void descriptor with greater ease. You may learn and cast such spells as if they were one spell level lower (to a minimum of 0thlevel) than the listed spell level for your spellcasting class.

Special: A 1st level legendary ninja may use their jutsu pool in place of a ki pool to qualify for this feat.
